notes.title: Save/Load bug fixed
notes.content:
The save function within the game was not working. 

- Fixed the in-game save/load function on the settings area of the phone.
- Game will now pause when in the camera/video app so the player can enjoy the entire scene before the girl completes the task.

notes.title: Cheat mode added
notes.content:
We've added a hidden cheat button in the game. For those that want to get to the action more quickly. Clicking on the Wi-Fi icon on the phone once in a game will max out all properties and add $50k to your cash. Any in-game achievements are disabled for that game.
